scope: Software correctness and cost-sensitivity study using frozen real visual candidate scores and synthetic passage/RFID/timing inputs. Not a field RFID dataset or measured PYNQ performance.
visual_sources: Five frozen conditions from identity_training/results/study; all declared seeds retained; no new threshold optimisation
population: 60 curated crop queries of12 author identity labels; each query mapped to a constructed event. Repeated images/identities across scenarios do not create independent real passages.
truth_separation: Truth used only for generating controlled RF perturbations/dropouts and scoring. Resolver accepts opaque event/snapshot IDs, observed RF records, a tag registry and model candidate scores; no expected identity/cohort fields.

association.rule: Deduplicate codes within the event window; require a single usable code and one-to-one read/event eligibility. Shared reads across visible event windows remain ambiguous. Late arrivals are retained but never used retroactively at an earlier deadline. Unique valid wrong-code inputs remain an explicit failure case.

queue.units: abstract tick, no conversion to seconds or FPS
queue.dispatch: Release frontend and background arrivals, expire waiting jobs, enforce admission, then give frontend priority except inside nonpreemptive background execution. Background completion at deadline is accepted. No post-horizon drain.
queue.cooperative_assumption: Background work can pause/resume at one-tick boundaries. This requires an actual resumable execution path or independently provisioned resource on hardware; an opaque full-model call does not gain this capability from thread priority.

accounting: For constructed events N=C+W+U+M, extra outputs separately. Observed events with missing snapshots, admission failure, timeout or unfinished tasks are U; absent visual event is M. Queue-only experiment assumes event inputs and does not translate frame deadline misses into real counting recall.
review: Test truth independence, timestamp boundaries, shared reads, duplicates, invalid/late inputs, return passages, unknown candidates, deadline and capacity behaviour, budget conservation and all ledger statuses. Independent scorer recomputes RF outcomes and queue timeline arithmetic.
